description: Pressures assent by framing disagreement as moral failure rather than addressing reasons.
example_minimal: If you disagree, you must be cruel.
notes_epistemic: Often co-occurs with identity-laundering; annotate disjunctively when also ad hominem.

description: Uses institutional credentials/frameworks to foreclose evaluation of underlying claims or processes.
example_minimal: The committee says it's fair, so it is.
notes_epistemic: Flag when authority is used as substitute for challengeable evidence.

description: Construes the option space as two exclusive choices when plausible alternatives exist.
example_minimal: Either accept this, or chaos follows.

description: Uses compliance vocabulary, governance frameworks, and procedural register to foreclose questioning of underlying claims or failures.
example_minimal: Our established framework ensures inherent fairness.
notes_epistemic: Primary pattern in SEC technical filings. Distinct from Institutional Shielding by emphasis on process vocabulary over named authority.

description: Organizes factual elements to guide interpretation toward a particular conclusion without making an explicit argument.
example_minimal: The filing emphasizes remediation costs, highlighting investor impact.
notes_epistemic: Common in editorial interpretations of SEC filings. Not a classical fallacy; annotate only when steering is strong enough to distort.

description: Deploys expert credentials, institutional affiliations, or scientific consensus as substitute for addressing the substance of a claim.
example_minimal: Science says this is settled; Harvard researchers confirm.
notes_epistemic: Maps to engine scientism flag. Rare in SEC corpus but common in policy and science-communication domains.

description: Amplifies threat severity or existential risk to foreclose deliberation and compel immediate action.
example_minimal: Without this measure, total collapse is inevitable.
notes_epistemic: Maps to high disruption_density + heart_density. Present in editorial survival narratives.

description: Redirects attention from the contested claim by declaring the challenge irrelevant, settled, or unworthy of response.
example_minimal: That is beside the point. Obviously, no serious person would question this.
notes_epistemic: Maps to engine evasion_count. Tests whether deflection blocks contestation rather than addressing it.
